headline: Three Delimitation Bills introduced — Lok Sabha to expand to 850 seats
detail: Constitution Amendment, Delimitation, and UT Laws Bills tabled together, triggering concern from southern states.

headline: No-confidence motion against Speaker Om Birla filed by opposition
detail: Opposition cited procedural high-handedness — only the second such motion in recent parliamentary history.

headline: Waqf Amendment: Rajya Sabha sits until 4 AM amid heated debate
detail: Owaisi and Sibal led opposition. One rebel abstention recorded in final division vote.

headline: G-RAM-G Bill passed after 1 AM in Lok Sabha
detail: Passed despite opposition walkout; two INC members abstained.

headline: Securities Markets Code sent to Standing Committee on Finance
detail: Bill consolidating 8 securities laws referred; former SEBI chief M. Damodaran deposed.
